what: Blurred gradient blob behind the section edge — two round lights stagger and swell and shrink over 6s (ease-in-out back and forth). On entering the screen it rises 15px over .89s cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1) while fading in over 1.19s cubic-bezier(.445,.05,.55,.95) (40ms delay). On leaving it hides again and the shimmer stops.

options.dur: One ripple (sec), default 6 — source video lengths 5.3·5.7·6·8.3
options.--fx-c1 · --fx-c2 · --fx-c3: Center light · outer light · staggered light colors (via style), default accent color and its hue wheel -50° · -115°
options.--fx-fade · --fx-rise · --fx-delay: Appear · rise duration and delay (via style), default 1.19s · .89s · 40ms

note: The original lays a blurred blob as a video (mp4) — redone with two CSS radial gradients so colors follow when the skin changes. The consumer sets the size (the blob sits 10~24% inside the element)
